final_message:
I wrote and validated the discrepancy report comparing the USCIS receipt notice against the five petition documents; it lists 26 findings (3 critical, 4 high, 11 medium, 8 low).
The most serious are the transposed A-Number (receipt A-217-854-903 vs. submission A-217-845-903), the missing $600 Asylum Program Fee (the $3,520 check should have been $4,120), and no sign that USCIS accepted the premium processing request; others include the March 17 vs. March 15 receipt date, the dropped middle name, and the fee and date errors inside the package.
